raster_style.method: Source chromatic-fill median versus actual cream bitmap background median (channels >220), not the coal plate behind the opaque bitmap. Lock outer black runs at original y=360 scaled by CSS contain height.

evidence.area_method: Full viewport denominator; current seg1b bounding boxes. Background/border paint and fitted RGB motif rectangles; exclude hollow-node interiors and contain letterboxing. SVG routes/brackets sampled at <=1 source px; stroke width rounded up to device pixels. All positive-alpha UI counted in overlap; only alpha=1 subtracted from visible terrain. Whole landmark boxes used for stricter core test.
